messages.subject: Caspian Atlas — revised SLA (99.7% + enhanced credits)
messages.plaintextBody:
Adam, Marcus,

As discussed, the revised Schedule 3 SLA moves the availability target to 99.7% and introduces a tiered service-credit table capped at 15% of one month's platform fee. I'll circulate the updated schedule with the execution version. No change to the support response targets.

Shout if anything looks off.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100 | whitfieldcarter.com
